selection_rule: Among models statistically indistinguishable from the top performer by DeLong's test (p>0.05) across pooled out-of-fold predictions, the most parsimonious model was selected (Occam's razor), favouring interpretability for the downstream SHAP analysis.
imbalance_handling: Class-weighted variant benchmarked alongside unweighted; SMOTE deliberately avoided (high-dimensional, leakage-prone).
